title: Persiste la brecha de género en los Consejos de Administración y la Alta Dirección
summary: La presencia de mujeres en los consejos de administración en México subió de 14.3% a 14.8%, aún muy por debajo del promedio de 34% de la OCDE. El estudio 'Mujeres en las empresas 2026' muestra que la brecha también persiste en la alta dirección.

title: SAP Touts AI Tools, But Fails to Disclose Numbers to Measure Results
summary: SAP is promoting its AI tools but has disclosed few metrics showing whether the effort is paying off. That gap makes the return on its AI push hard to measure.

title: Anthropic’s Mythos AI Looking for Cyber Flaws in Energy Systems
summary: Some US power companies are now using Anthropic's Mythos AI to hunt for cybersecurity flaws in energy systems. They had spent months pressing government officials and Anthropic for access to its most powerful models to fend off hackers.

title: US Mortgage Rates Fall for Fourth Week, Lifting Home Purchases
summary: US mortgage rates fell for a fourth straight week, pushing home-purchase applications up by the most since mid-April. The drop gives a small lift to a deflated housing market.

title: IFRS 18: ¿realmente aplica a todas las empresas en México?
summary: IFRS 18 entra en vigor en 2027 y cambiará la presentación de los estados financieros, aunque no todas las empresas en México estarán obligadas a aplicarla. El artículo explica quién debe adoptarla y por qué la distinción importa.

title: CoreWeave Quiets Doubts, US CPI Fuels Fed-Hike Bets
summary: US stock futures rose on CoreWeave's results and demand for Anthropic's IPO. Meanwhile, short-term Treasury yields jumped the most in 19 months after hotter-than-expected CPI, and Fed officials warned that rates may need to rise.

title: AI Doubts Collide With Anthropic’s Mega IPO
summary: Anthropic is going public just as investors grow worried about the outlook for artificial intelligence. The tension between IPO demand and AI-bubble doubts frames the listing.

title: Más política que monetaria
summary: Columna que analiza las decisiones de tasa de Banxico y argumenta que hoy pesan más los factores políticos que los estrictamente monetarios. El autor retoma ideas de Woodford sobre cómo las expectativas de hogares y productores transmiten la política monetaria.

title: AI Stocks Face Tug-of-War as Anthropic, CoreWeave Lift Hopes
summary: The AI trade is now so big that its supporters and skeptics often find backing on the same day. Anthropic's IPO and CoreWeave's results are lifting hopes even as doubts persist.

title: Airbnb Is Building Its Own AI Travel Agent, Co-Founder Says
summary: Airbnb co-founder Nathan Blecharczyk says the company is building its own specialized AI travel agent that will eventually book stays both on and off Airbnb. He also discussed Airbnb's return to growth and regulation of housing in Europe.

title: Kai-Fu Lee Questions Soaring AI Valuations
summary: Kai-Fu Lee questions whether trillion-dollar AI valuations can be justified, pointing to circular funding and cheaper Chinese and open-source models. He argues businesses must reinvent themselves around AI and that Europe's opportunity lies in applications.

title: Anthropic IPO Demand Surges as AI Trade Roars Back
summary: Traders piled back into the AI trade after strong CoreWeave results and robust demand for Anthropic's IPO, lifting US stock futures. The briefing also covers US-led Ukraine–Russia peace talks in Abu Dhabi.

title: AI Has Driven a Quarter of UK Growth This Year, Analysis Shows
summary: Bloomberg economists estimate that AI has driven about a quarter of UK growth this year. That leaves the country exposed if a global downturn hits AI valuations.

title: Anthropic’s IPO is too important to fail
summary: Huge demand points to a blockbuster debut for Anthropic's IPO. But the FT warns that shadow insider sales and circular supply-chain backing could cause after-market indigestion.

title: UBS’ Laud Sees Underpriced Risk in AI's ‘Web of Debt’
summary: UBS Asset Management's Sonja Laud says the AI boom has shifted from an equity story to a balance-sheet story driven by debt. She warns that markets are underestimating the interconnected 'web of debt' across public and private credit and equity.

title: ByteDance Prepares Muse-Like Agent in Push to Close AI Gap
summary: ByteDance plans to release a Muse-like AI assistant in the coming weeks, building on its lead in AI video. The company hopes the launch helps it close the gap with top US labs within as little as three years.

title: Anthropic Aims for $3 Billion to $3.5 Billion in Japan Offering
summary: Anthropic is seeking $3bn–$3.5bn from Japanese investors as part of its IPO, now that the frontier AI lab has formally begun marketing the offering. The plan keeps the fundraising target within Japan.

title: How much is Anthropic really worth? Use our calculator
summary: As Anthropic prepares its Wall Street debut, the FT has an interactive calculator that lets readers test whether the Claude maker is worth $500bn or $4tn.

title: Inside Ken Griffin’s $5bn Miami takeover
summary: Billionaire Ken Griffin has poured about $5bn into Miami as he tries to mould his ideal city. He found that his clout went further in Florida.

title: Nvidia pasa por un “bache”, la BMV gana terreno y el peso se deprecia ante el dólar
summary: Cierre de mercados: Nvidia tuvo un bache, la BMV ganó terreno y el peso se depreció frente al dólar.

title: Chedraui se alía con Toka para que 3 millones de usuarios puedan pagar con su celular en sus tiendas
summary: Chedraui se alió con la fintech Toka para que unos 3 millones de usuarios puedan pagar con su celular en sus tiendas. El acuerdo amplía los pagos digitales en el comercio minorista mexicano.

title: CoreWeave Quiets Doubts Over AI Business With Upbeat Outlook
summary: CoreWeave eased fears about its debt-laden business with an upbeat quarterly report, showing sales growth is still strong. The results came despite challenges facing the data center industry.

title: CFE Fibra E inicia reuniones con inversionistas por nueva emisión de hasta US$867 millones
summary: CFECapital inició reuniones con inversionistas para una oferta subsecuente de la CFE Fibra E por US$580 millones, ampliable hasta US$867 millones. Los recursos apoyarían la modernización y expansión de las redes eléctricas de México.

title: La IA apenas pidió cuatro viajes en Uber; DiDi también reconoce baja adopción
summary: Uber reconoció que agentes de IA apenas solicitaron cuatro viajes en su plataforma, y DiDi también admite una baja adopción. La nota evidencia lo lejos que está aún el uso real de agentes de IA en servicios de consumo.

title: Secretaría de Hacienda busca mayor inversión en Plan México y las Afores jugarían un papel relevante
summary: Hacienda busca atraer mayor inversión al Plan México, y las Afores jugarían un papel relevante en el financiamiento de proyectos. Es una señal sobre el destino del ahorro previsional hacia infraestructura y activos productivos.

title: Ocaso House / JE arquitectos + Leo Alvarez
summary: Casa Ocaso, by JE arquitectos and Leo Alvarez in Chelem, Yucatán, responds to a constantly changing coastline. It was designed so three friends can share one home without giving up their privacy.

title: Presidente Pedro Alliana asegura que casi el 95% de los ahorristas de Ueno Bank ya recuperó su dinero
summary: El presidente paraguayo Pedro Alliana afirmó que casi el 95% de los ahorristas de Ueno Bank ya recuperó su dinero tras la quiebra de la entidad. El caso es una referencia regional sobre resolución bancaria y protección de depositantes.

title: Bolsa Mexicana espera nuevas emisiones de acciones en 2027: qué falta para atraer capital
summary: La BMV espera concretar emisiones simplificadas de acciones en 2027 como vía para impulsar el mercado de capitales mexicano. En el Bloomberg Línea Summit México 2026 se discutieron los retos de liquidez, regulación y acceso a la inversión que frenan nuevas colocaciones.

title: Anthropic IPO: Claude Maker Seeks Up to $1.5 Trillion Valuation
summary: Anthropic's IPO bankers are weighing raising the target valuation to $1.5 trillion or more, according to an FT report. The move signals robust investor demand for the Claude maker's listing.

title: Bartleby newsletter: Can AI write newsletters
summary: The Economist's Bartleby columnist Andrew Palmer asks whether AI can write newsletters, with bad news for some email writers.
